home.ready.title: This instance is ready to set up
home.ready.intro: Create the owner account and tell Freeholder about the business. It takes about a minute, and nothing is permanent except who owns the site.
home.live.note: The public site arrives with the cms module. Until then, this page confirms the platform is serving your business.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.intro: Owners and staff only. Customers get a link by email instead.
setup.owner.title: Create your owner account
setup.owner.intro: This is the account that owns the site. It can only be created once, so keep the details somewhere safe.
setup.owner.emailHint: You will sign in with this.
setup.owner.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase beats a short complicated one.
setup.business.title: Tell us about the business
setup.business.intro: Your country fills in the rest. Everything here appears on your public site, and you can change any of it later.
setup.done.title: {name} is ready
setup.done.intro: Finishing locks this wizard, so nobody can walk through it again on a live site. Your settings stay editable from the admin.
setup.done.summary: Publishing in {locales}, charging in {currency}, showing times in {timezone}.
business.name: Business name
business.schemaTypeHint: Search engines use this to describe you. It can change later.
business.localesHint: Comma separated. The first one is your default and stays unprefixed in your web addresses.
admin.nav.label: Admin sections
admin.overview.title: Overview
admin.overview.intro: Everything below is live from your own data.
admin.overview.contactsEmpty: No contacts yet. They arrive on their own once forms and checkout are live, and you can add one by hand at any time.
admin.overview.activityEmpty: Nothing has changed yet. Every action anyone takes — you, your staff, or an AI agent — is recorded here.
admin.settings.title: Settings
admin.settings.intro: Who this business is, and the conventions the whole site follows.
admin.settings.saved: Saved. Your public site uses these straight away.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.intro: Everyone this business has touched. One record per person, shared by every part of the platform.
contacts.new.intro: Every part of the platform will share this one record.
contacts.count: {count, plural, =0 {No contacts yet} one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. Add one by hand, or let forms and checkout bring them in.
contacts.column.name: Name
contacts.detail.timelineEmpty: Nothing yet. Quotes, bookings, invoices and emails will all appear here as they happen.
contacts.field.name: Name
contacts.field.emailHint: One contact per address — the platform will not create a second.
contacts.field.notesHint: Only you and your staff see these.
contacts.merge.title: Merge a duplicate
contacts.merge.intro: Find the other record for this person. Its history moves here, and anything this contact is missing is filled in from it. The duplicate is then removed — this cannot be undone.
cms.block.heading: Heading
cms.pages.title: Pages
cms.pages.intro: Every page on your public site. Rearranging one is a save, not a deploy.
cms.pages.newIntro: It starts empty and unpublished. Add blocks next, publish when you are ready.
cms.sections.title: Chrome
cms.sections.intro: The header and footer around every page, and any arrangement you have saved to reuse.
cms.sections.editIntro: This appears on every page of your site.
cms.revisions.title: Version history
cms.revisions.empty: No earlier versions yet. One is kept every time you save.
cms.editor.empty: Nothing here yet. Add your first block.
cms.editor.saveFailed: That change could not be saved.
cms.field.slugHint: Lowercase words separated by hyphens. Leave empty for the home page.
